computation_level: Verified only after audit and tests pass
design: Post hoc analysis revision prompted by independent review; neither prospective nor registered. Original panel results and source files remain immutable.
prior_exposure: The original panel scores, single-gene omission scores, per-gene transformed values and seven-gene raw counts have been inspected before this contract. Rank and top-abundance sensitivity outcomes have not been computed before this contract.

source_study.citation: Lu et al., Cell 2025, Prevalent mesenchymal drift in aging and disease is reversed by partial reprogramming

replication: Eight libraries, one donor GM00731, male age 96; two libraries per condition with no assumption of independent biological replication or paired library labels. No p-values, donor inference or age contrast.
panels: Retain all five previously scored panels, including the full nine-gene panel and seven-gene panel excluding POU5F1/SOX2. A feature present with zero counts remains in the denominator. No outcome-selected deletion or replacement.
availability: Report exact mapped Ensembl ID, presence in matrix, number of nonzero libraries, raw counts and sum for every panel gene. Matrix presence is distinct from expression detection and biological absence.

decomposition.gene_delta: Arithmetic mean treated transformed value minus arithmetic mean control transformed value; library labels are not paired.
decomposition.additive_contribution: gene_delta / original_panel_size; the sum equals the full panel difference.
decomposition.signed_share: gene_delta / sum(all panel gene_deltas), null when total is zero. This may be negative or exceed one in opposing effects.
decomposition.absolute_share: abs(gene_delta) / sum(abs(all panel gene_deltas)), null when denominator is zero.
decomposition.omission: Recompute mean over N-1 genes; record effect, four unpaired library differences, sign, and retained magnitude abs(omitted_effect)/abs(full_effect). A retained sign is separate from retained magnitude.
decomposition.report_scope: All genes in all original panels under original and newly specified sensitivity transforms. No inferred state labels.

normalizations.original_replay: Independently reproduce log2(1+CPM) and positive-all-eight median-ratio CPM-equivalent transforms from raw counts, requiring absolute agreement <= 1e-10 with every original stored gene value, panel difference and omission value.
normalizations.rank: Within each library, rank all 62703 features ascending using average tied 1-based ranks. If z genes have zero counts, let r0=(z+1)/2; if z=0 let r0=0. Zero-valued features score 0; positive features score (rank-r0)/(N-r0). Equal-weight panel means yield zero-anchored relative-rank units, not log-expression units. Rank is invariant to a positive scalar change in a library but remains dependent on within-library composition and detection; it is not immune to composition.
normalizations.top_abundance: Rank all features by their mean CPM across eight libraries, breaking ties by Ensembl ID. For k in [10,100], exclude the same top-k features from every normalization denominator. Retain original panel numerators, even if a panel feature is excluded from the denominator. Let T_j be remaining count sum and L_j full depth; effective depth is T_j*geomean(L)/geomean(T). Transform log2(1+count/effective_depth*1e6). Report all excluded feature IDs, panel overlap and excluded fractions. This is a normalization sensitivity, not correction of a proven artifact.

forbidden_inferences: A calibrated reprogramming or pluripotency classifier
An inactive endogenous pluripotency network from low or zero RNA counts
Biological absence in every cell or at protein level
Proven technical confounding from detected-gene differences
True rare-state prevalence, safety, retinal efficacy or age rejuvenation
Independent study validation of the SRSF1 classifier
determinism: Python standard library only; deterministic sorting, no random sampling, no timestamps or mutable runtime metadata in numerical outputs. Serialize sorted JSON; validate raw-source hashes and immutable prior hashes before and after run.
gse297234_scope: Metadata and prior-analysis scout only. A separate post hoc per-cell contract requires root freeze before calculating extension outcomes.
